TICKET
# Shop Parameters > Search - Alias is duplicated instead of updated

When we edit an alias in the page 'Shop parameters > Search', a new alias is created.

## Attendu
When we edit an alias, the alias should be updated and not duplicated.

## Étapes
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to 'Shop Parameters>Search' page
2. Click on 'Edit' the first alias
3. Edit for example 'blue' by 'red'
4. See error -> a new alias is created instead to update

**Screenshots**
https://www.awesomescreenshot.com/video/3646993?key=b9e0d8d3fca3fa78128e604d8d14573a

Edit Blue by red
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24647495/98929003-d3370180-24da-11eb-8f76-733dd09d2827.png)

Result after update
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24647495/98928922-af73bb80-24da-11eb-86bf-a718d6aeb94e.png)

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).

RÉSULTATS DE RECHERCHE (fichier, nb de lignes)
controllers/admin/AdminSearchController.php (1)
controllers/admin/AdminSearchConfController.php (2)

ÉTAPE 2 LIRE. Réponds en JSON : {"files": ["..."]} (1 à 3 fichiers).
